_about: The pattern library (2026-09-10): reusable interaction recipes measured in the joint validation loop. One entry per pattern: how to recognise it on a parsed row (match), the keyword form and the xpath form CRT runs (placeholders: {label} {value} {index} {xpath} {attr_<name>} {anchor_kw} and any key in args), the read-back, the wait signal, the known failure, and the pages it held on. Entries are ordered specific -> general; the first match wins. The library never edits the parser: it is the interaction layer over what the parser found. Consumers: tools/recorder/patterns.py (match/recipe), review_table.py build (stamps row.pattern), robot_call (recipe when a row has no corrected call), the recorder's draft step. {anchor_kw} (2026-09-18) is D4's slot on any keyword form that locates by {label}/{label_base}: it renders '    anchor=<n>' when the row's group_size > 1 and '' when it occurs once -- pattern_library.recipe() computes it via disambiguation_args.to_call_kwargs, so a repeated control always carries QWeb's numeric anchor and a single one never does, matching the doctrine generic composers (compose_live._anchor_of, review_table.robot_call) already enforce outside the library. Found as a gap in native-select-dropdown (a select whose label group_size > 1 emitted no anchor at all); fixed there and audited into every other recipe that locates by {label}/{label_base}: clarity-lookup, adjacent-span-label-button, count-suffixed-button, tab-with-count-in-same-node. A recipe that locates by an attribute or an xpath (inline-edit-pencil, slotted-text-button-by-value, dueling-list-hand-built, pill-combobox-click-then-text) or a fixed literal (lightning-modal-cancel-and-close) is not in scope for this slot -- its locator does not resolve by the row's own label text.

patterns.name: search-as-you-type lookup (cds-select-input): type, pick the option INSIDE the host, read back the pill
patterns.readback: the selected-value pill span.csi__single-value-label under the host; the searchbox placeholder disappears after a pick so VerifyInputValue by placeholder cannot be the read-back
patterns.wait: a dependent lookup stays aria-disabled until its parent is picked and its choices load (13.0 s measured); the keyword timeout is the wait, never a sleep; the pill rendered 10.3 s after the click
patterns.known_failure: ClickText {value} resolves the same text anywhere on the page (the templates table behind the modal had 23 'Account'); anchor=<label> fails when the label text is also a table header; the option must QUALIFY (a credential must be authenticated: copado__Org__c.copado__Validated_Status__c = 'OK') -- query first, then click the exact full text

patterns.name: a native <select>: DropDown by label, VerifySelectedOption
patterns.known_failure: PickList does not select a native <select> (measured 2026-09-10); DropDown by label works even when the label is a cousin

patterns.name: a combobox whose label QWeb cannot reach: click the selector box by xpath, then ClickText the option
patterns.readback: the option text visible after the pick (a pill or the input value)
patterns.wait: the option list opens on the click; ClickText's timeout is the wait
patterns.known_failure: ClickText <label> only clicks the label (user, 2026-09-10); a vacuous 'list opened' check counts always-visible options

patterns.name: an SLDS dueling list without lightning-dual-listbox: ClickText the option, click the move-right control, verify it under Selected
patterns.readback: the option text under the Selected column
patterns.known_failure: the move control's class is the page's own (zn-arrow-r on Zoo_Nightmare_Inputs); a standard lightning-dual-listbox takes the QForce MultiPickList keyword instead

patterns.name: a record page's inline-edit pencil: ClickItem by its title
patterns.known_failure: the pencil has no visible text; ClickText finds nothing

patterns.name: a button whose visible text arrives through a <slot> and repeats on the page: ClickItem by its value attribute
patterns.known_failure: ClickText index 1 and 2 both landed on the other 'New Task' (the text is slotted)

patterns.name: a Clarity data-grid row checkbox (cds-checkbox host carries the aria-label, the input does not): click the input under the host by the host's aria-label
keyword_form: # no keyword reaches this control (measured live 2026-09-15): ClickCheckbox {aria_label} found nothing in 15 s
patterns.readback: the input's is_selected() flips true; on the Commit Experience the Dependency Analysis button immediately reads 'Analyzing dependencies' then enables (the analysis auto-runs on selection)
patterns.wait: none before the click; after it the 'Analyzing dependencies' label is the signal that the selection registered
patterns.known_failure: ClickCheckbox by the aria-label text: the label sits on the <cds-checkbox> host, QWeb's checkbox locator reads the <input> and its <label>, which carry nothing (Select row Flow:Opportunity_Creation_Automation, na.devops.copado.com/en/commit)

patterns.name: a Clarity data-grid action cell (cds-table-cell role=button holding only an icon, e.g. Compare): click it by the text of its own row
keyword_form: # no keyword reaches this control: the cell has no text, only a cds-icon svg; ClickItem needs an attribute value the icon does not carry
patterns.readback: the panel it opens (Compare: 'Flow: <name>' with a Changes strip; a spinner first, the diagram 8-12 s later, 0.5 s when cached)
patterns.wait: poll for the panel heading, then for the Changes strip before clicking anything inside it (Explain Changes clicked before the strip rendered did not open its panel)
patterns.known_failure: while the grid's search box highlights, the row text is split by a <mark> element; a normalize-space() on the span still matches the whole text, a contains() on <mark> only matches the highlighted part

patterns.name: a button whose label carries a live count in parentheses (Dependency Analysis (2), Get Previously Commited (9)): click by the label without the count, partial match ON
patterns.readback: the label itself: it reads 'Dependency Analysis' before the analysis ran and 'Dependency Analysis (2)' after; the count is the state
patterns.wait: the count appears when the work behind the button finishes; verify the count, never the bare label, to know it ran
patterns.known_failure: partial_match=False on the counted form fails the moment the count changes; the store's match rule (pom/match.py) drops the count when matching, so the stored element survives the relabel

patterns.name: the close X of a Clarity offcanvas panel (aria-label 'Close diff'): it sits under the global topbar, so a native click is intercepted -- click it through JavaScript
keyword_form: # ClickItem {aria_label} is intercepted: 'element click intercepted ... <header class=global-topbar> would receive the click' (measured 2026-09-15)
patterns.readback: the panel heading is gone from the DOM
patterns.wait: a 250 ms poll on the heading's absence
patterns.known_failure: ClickElement on the same xpath: ElementClickInterceptedException at (1469, 80), the point under the fixed header

patterns.name: the X of a Lightning quick-action modal: its title is 'Cancel and close', never 'Close'
patterns.readback: the modal title is gone and the URL returns from /lightning/action/quick/... to the record (the quick action is its own page key while open)
patterns.wait: a 250 ms poll on the URL leaving /lightning/action/quick/
patterns.known_failure: //button[@title="Close"] resolves a different button (a toast or banner dismiss) and the modal stays open (measured 2026-09-15, Revenue Cloud Settings on cicd-demo)

patterns.name: a tab or pill whose count sits in the same text node as its label ('Standard Rules 2'): verify with partial match, never exact
patterns.readback: the tab's aria-selected flips; the count is the number of rows under it
patterns.known_failure: VerifyText {label_base} exact: the read-back guard refuses it as SilentWrongValue ('asked for Standard Rules but resolved Standard Rules\n2'); loosening the guard is the wrong fix, partial=True is the honest form

patterns.name: the Zoo Nightmare Inputs reactive text fields (Contract Term, Renewal Notice (days), Amount, Approved Budget): real TypeText's own clear_key is not reliable on this shape -- clear, type, read back, verify
patterns.readback: GetInputValue    {label}{anchor_kw}, compared lenient (trim; digits-only for a numeric render, '25000' == '25,000.00')
patterns.known_failure: plain TypeText appends on reactive LWC inputs (docs/errors/entries/576d7e8859.json: on this holder neither {CONTROL + a} nor {COMMAND + a} cleared a reactive lightning-input at all -- 'GZREV Phone' retyped over 'GZREV Phone' read back 'GZREV PhoneGZREV Phone'; separately, tools/qforce-lite/qforce_lite.py type_text_clearing's own docstring measured a percent-formatted numeric field grow 25% -> 2,025% -> 202,525% across repeated attempts WITH clear_key already applied) -- CRT's stock TypeText has no answer to either shape beyond the one clear_key chord

patterns.name: a control whose label repeats on the page: the member's index as QWeb's numeric anchor
patterns.known_failure: a member QWeb cannot see (a wizard step not yet shown) makes anchor=2 land on member 1 ('Found 1 elements. Given anchor was 2'); the xpath //label[normalize-space(.)="{label}"]/following::input[1] reaches it

patterns.name: Save / Submit / Delete: exported as a comment, run by the user after checking the form
patterns.known_failure: ClickText Save without partial_match=False clicks 'Save & New'

patterns.name: a button whose visible label is two adjacent spans ('Available Parent Objects' + '(25)'): the parser joins them with a space the DOM does not have
patterns.known_failure: ClickText with the parser's label ('Available Parent Objects (25)') found nothing live; the DOM text is 'Available Parent Objects(25)' -- measured 2026-09-10, no working keyword form recorded yet; the xpath form (unique preceding text) resolved

roster_order._about: LOOP 3 / A4 (2026-09-20): per-platform locator-roster order, measured from the live verdicts already recorded in docs/recorder/review/*/review.json (the keyword track: row.live.keyword against calls[0] -- tier1 label keyword when calls[0].keyword != 'ClickItem', tier2 attribute keyword when it is 'ClickItem'; the xpath track: row.xpath.live against row.xpath.rung, grouped tier3 anchored-on-text-or-attribute (unique_preceding_text/text_node/text_tag/scoped_text/sibling_scope/stable_attr/scoped_attr/scoped_attr_positional), tier4 parent-label (label_association/scoped_label), tier5 positional (structural/positional_last_resort). Ranked by the 95% Wilson LOWER BOUND (tools/benchmark/metrics.wilson), not the raw rate, among tiers with n(pass+bug)>=10; a tier under 10 is listed last with note 'n too small'. Full measurement: docs/audit/roster-order-2026-09-20.md, atoms: docs/audit/roster-order/atoms-2026-09-20.jsonl. CAVEAT carried forward from that report: the xpath track's rung was already filtered for uniqueness before being live-tested (row.xpath.rung is the FIRST ladder rung that was unique_in_capture); the keyword track's hint (calls[0]) carries no equivalent pre-filter. tier3 ranking #1 on every platform here is consistent with that construction bias as well as with a real effect, and this measurement cannot separate the two. Consumed by tools/recorder/pattern_library.py:roster_form_for_platform() only when GZ_ROSTER_BY_PLATFORM=1 (default OFF, D-2026-09-20). No entry here is prescriptive: it describes what was measured, same doctrine as the locator hints themselves (D14).
